The Property

This is not your typical Boulder rental. Unit 308 at Pendleton Square has been completely remodeled from the ground up — brand-new engineered hardwood floors, a designer kitchen with quartz countertops and stainless cabinetry, and two fully renovated spa-style bathrooms with fresh tile throughout. Add in vaulted ceilings, a wood-burning fireplace, a sun-drenched south-facing balcony, and an in-unit washer and dryer, and you have one of the most turnkey rentals available in north Boulder right now.
